Name: Goose
Author: omena007
Description:
This mod adds geese in the game as farm animals. Geese cost 5000 gold and live in the deluxe barn (like ostriches they are too big for the coop door, if you want these big birds to inhabit coops use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33514]Animal Squeeze Through[/url]). You can unlock them by having a Deluxe Barn and 6 hearts with Marnie and reading her letter. Geese produce eggs that can be turned into mayo and drop down feathers (unlock production with friendship points). There's also a surprise item if you treat the geese well and earn their trust. Geese can swim and I recommend to use[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15860] Like a duck to water mod [/url]if you want them to do so more often. You need ostrich incubator (that is now renamed Large Incubator) in the barn if you want to hatch more geese.

Mod has a config option for mayo sprites: vanilla or one matching my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22721]Mayo Makeover[/url] mod.

*New* there are two fishing lure changes: Both [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Curiosity_Lure]Curiosity Lure[/url] and [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Quality_Bobber]Quality Bobber[/url] use feathers in their recipes (like real life lures), you can unlock Curiosity Lure recipe by having 8 hearts with Willy.

Gift Tastes:

[spoiler]
Emily loves goose down, Krobus loves the surprise items, Wizard loves the other surprise item, Sebastian, Abigail and Dwarf hate goose mayo.
[/spoiler]

Surprise Items:

[spoiler]

Downloads.Description: This versions doesn't have a requirement of 8 hearts with Marnie (you still need a deluxe barn) and you don't need as many hearts with the animals to get the produce. This version doesn't have the lures and doesn't receive updates.
